title: Phroneme weekly practice journal
descriptionHtml:
A reusable journal for choosing one action, making a realistic weekly plan, and reflecting on what happened.

What is included

  • A printable HTML worksheet.
  • An editable Markdown worksheet.
  • Space for your action, timing, fallback, daily observations, and weekly review.

How to use it

  1. Choose one action you want to make room for.
  2. Give it a time or cue and a realistic fallback.
  3. Record what happened and choose one change for next week.

What this tool provides

This is a planning and reflection worksheet. It does not provide a training prescription, nutrition plan, diagnosis, or individualized medical advice. It has not been evaluated as a health intervention and makes no promise about weight, appearance, fitness, or other health outcomes.

Your notes

Your completed journal stays with you. There is no requirement to submit it or share personal health information.
